rationale.conceptual: The method uses well-known Halpin-Tsai composite theory and linear elastic FEA, but requires non-trivial implementation of geometry parameterization, material property assignment, and the coupling between CAD and FEA. Not novel but multi-component.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves generating 36 parametric CAD models, computing composite properties, running FEA for 8 cases with CalculiX (meshing, applying boundary conditions, solving, extracting reaction forces), and computing effective modulus. Automating the CAD generation and FEA steps across different designs and materials using external tools is complex and fragile.
